text: A component is proved only by its own proof result (#234, #242): one that passed, names a verifier, has no errors, names that exact component among those it verified, covers every contract selected for it, and carries snapshots that match the inventory, source and contract hashes included. Anything less leaves it unchecked, and a proof never passes to a neighbor or to a declaration used as a contract, even one the same run names as verified. Proof stays apart from the evidence kinds still to come, bounded or sampled conformance, runtime checks and trusted assumptions, and no score merges them. Fingerprints bind the whole scope, unchecked neighbors and files without functions included. Receipts escape source-derived text in Markdown, so no filename can forge a status. Legacy receipts are unchanged, and explicit component checks stay refused until adapters run them.
